signature: SUBROUTINE ZTFSM( TRANSR, SIDE, UPLO, TRANS, DIAG, M, N, ALPHA, A,

params.name: transr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: The Normal Form of RFP A is stored;
-   `= 'C'`: The Conjugate-transpose Form of RFP A is stored.

params.name: side
params.reference:
On entry, `SIDE` specifies whether op( A ) appears on the left or right of X as follows:

$$
\mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'L'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'l'} \operatorname{op}( A ) \, X = \alpha \, B
$$

$$
\mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'R'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'r'} X \, \operatorname{op}( A ) = \alpha \, B
$$

Unchanged on exit.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
On entry, `UPLO` specifies whether the RFP matrix A came from an upper or lower triangular matrix as follows: `UPLO = 'U'` or 'u' RFP A came from an upper triangular matrix `UPLO = 'L'` or 'l' RFP A came from a lower triangular matrix

Unchanged on exit.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANS` specifies the form of op( A ) to be used in the matrix multiplication as follows:

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'N'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'n'} \operatorname{op}( A ) = A
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'C'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'c'} \operatorname{op}( A ) = \overline{ A' }
$$

Unchanged on exit.

params.name: diag
params.reference:
On entry, `DIAG` specifies whether or not RFP A is unit triangular as follows:

`DIAG = 'U'` or 'u' A is assumed to be unit triangular.

`DIAG = 'N'` or 'n' A is not assumed to be unit

triangular.

Unchanged on exit.

params.name: M
params.reference: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of B. M must be at least zero. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of B. N must be at least zero. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: On entry, `ALPHA` specifies the scalar $\alpha$. When $\alpha$ is zero then A is not referenced and B need not be set before entry. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: A
params.reference: $\mathrm{NT} = N \, (N+1)/2$. On entry, the matrix A in RFP Format. RFP Format is described by `TRANSR`, `UPLO` and N as follows: If `TRANSR='N'` then RFP A is (0:N,0:K-1) when N is even; $K=N/2$. RFP A is (0:N-1,0:K) when N is odd; $K=N/2$. If `TRANSR = 'C'` then RFP is the Conjugate-transpose of RFP A as defined when `TRANSR = 'N'`. The contents of RFP A are defined by `UPLO` as follows: If `UPLO = 'U'` the RFP A contains the NT elements of upper packed A either in normal or conjugate-transpose Format. If `UPLO = 'L'` the RFP A contains the NT elements of lower packed A either in normal or conjugate-transpose Format. The LDA of RFP A is (N+1)/2 when `TRANSR = 'C'`. When `TRANSR` is 'N' the LDA is N+1 when N is even and is N when is odd. See the Note below for more details. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: B
params.reference: Before entry, the leading m by n part of the array B must contain the right-hand side matrix B, and on exit is overwritten by the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: On entry, `LDB` specifies the first dimension of B as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDB` must be at least max( 1, m ). Unchanged on exit.
